subject.title: feat(ui): animated Clawd mascot on the new-session welcome hero

question: Should this PR land the full nine-mood reusable mascot now, or narrow the component to the idle welcome use case until additional consumers are ready?
rationale: The complete native-parity mood system is coherent, but most of its surface is not yet consumed and repository policy favors lean, bounded code unless the broader direction is intentional.

options.title: Keep full native-parity surface
options.body: Accept all nine moods as the canonical web mascot foundation after adding direct motion and reduced-motion proof.

options.title: Narrow to welcome idle
options.body: Land only the rendering and animation needed by the welcome hero, then add other moods with their first consumers.

recommendation.title: Keep full native-parity surface
recommendation.body: Accept all nine moods as the canonical web mascot foundation after adding direct motion and reduced-motion proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence connects this person to both the mascot direction and the proposed web implementation.
